newsitem.title: USA: Exxon enters Malaysia oil agreements.
newsitem.headline: Exxon enters Malaysia oil agreements.

text.p: Exxon Corp said on Friday that its Esso Production Malaysia Inc affiliate has signed two new production sharing contracts with Petroliam Nasional Berhad, Malaysia's national oil and gas company.
The new contracts cover two highly prospective blocks, SB 302 and H, which include new deep water acreage offshore Malaysia's State of Sabah, the company said.
Exxon said Block SB 302 is located approximately 50 miles (80 kilometers) offshore Sabah and encompasses about 1.2 million acres in water depths ranging from 165 to 650 feet (50 to 200 meters).

Block H is located northwest of Block SB 302, about 85 miles (135 kilometers) offshore Sabah and encompasses about two million acres in water depths ranging from 650 to 4,900 feet (200 to 1,500 meters), Exxon said.
Esso Production Malaysia, the operator for both blocks, will hold an 80 percent interest in both blocks, with the remainder being held by Petroliam Nasional Perhad (PETRONAS), Exxon said.

Plans for Blocks SB 302 and H include the reprocessing and reinterpretation of seismic data and the acquisition of an additional seismic later this year or in 1998, in advance of exploratory drilling, Exxon said.
